comments.value: I believe you should only import one SDK or the other. Not both.
@{5ff39d9fe22cc0618bebbd7d|full_name}: I imported both Avatar3.0 and World3.0.
@{5ff87acc25d7bd04a33c85aa|full_name}: You only want to import one or the other. Import ONLY the Avatar SDK if you're working on an Avatar for that project

@{5ff39d9fe22cc0618bebbd7d|full_name}: Thanks to your advice, I was able to successfully upload my avatar by installing only Avatar 3.0.
I apologize for the trouble I caused you by misreading your text.
It has reminded me that when I encounter a bug-like phenomenon, I should first question my own behavior.

details:
I created a new project in Unity 2018.4.20f1 and installed SDK3-World and SDK3-Avatars in that project.
Right after I finished setting up an avatar and clicked the "Build & Publish for Windows" button, a NotImplementedException was thrown. The details of the exception are long, so I will add them at the bottom.
This exception occurred even when I tried to upload just a cube with the "VRC Avatar Descriptor" and "Pipeline Manager" components.
To solve this problem, I re-installed Windows Build Support (IL2CPP) and restarted Unity with the whole computer, but it wasn't solved.
My computer environment is as follows.
OS: Windows 10 Home 64bit
CPU: AMD Ryzen 7 3700X 8-Core Processor
GPU: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2070 SUPER
Memory: 32GB
